lead: Sania Mirza is an Indian tennis player, born on 15 November 1986 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, she is 39 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.
She has represented India Billie Jean King Cup team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and BBC 100 Women.
This profile collects the Sania facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
